670:t_1:88.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「I think this space... is $$ミカゲ$$'s closed heart itself.」

670:t_1:89.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「So breaking through the dimensional wall with a song or a drill is...」

670:t_1:90.en:
$$シリウス$$
「Are you saying it's impossible?」

670:t_1:93.en:
$$カグラ$$
「If this is $$ミカゲ$$'s heart, then all we have to do is beat the bastard, right?」

670:t_1:94.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Then we'll be fine. Knowing him, he'll definitely come to finish us off with his own hands in the end.」

670:t_1:95.en:
$$アポロ$$
「If we beat him then, I'm sure we can get out of this space.」

670:t_1:97.en:
$$シュレード$$
「We cannot be too hopeful, since a curse can endure even after the one who cast it has perished.」

670:t_1:98.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「You mean beating him might not work?」

670:t_1:99.en:
$$シュレード$$
「It is only a possibility. We cannot say anything for certain yet.」

670:t_1:100.en:
$$カイエン$$
「But for now, we have to bet on it.」

670:t_1:101.en:
$$ジン$$
「There is still another concern: whether someone as cunning as $$ミカゲ$$ would risk appearing before us.」

670:t_1:102.en:
$$ジン$$
「If he does attack us, it will probably be when he is absolutely confident.」

670:t_1:104.en:
$$ジン$$
「...We may have to prepare ourselves for the worst...」

670:t_1:105.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「It can't end like this...! We've come so far!」

670:t_1:106.en:
$$アンディ$$
「That's right! I refuse to let it end with us dying forgotten in a place like this!」

670:t_1:107.en:
$$モロイ$$
「If only Supreme Commander $$不動$$ were here at a time like this...」

670:t_1:108.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「With his mysterious power, he could probably get us out of here.」

670:t_1:112.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Supreme Commander $$不動$$ isn't here. If we try to rely on someone who isn't here, we're sure to lose.」

670:t_1:113.en:
$$アポロ$$
「We don't need that old man's power. Let's turn this around with our own strength.」

670:t_1:115.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I don't know what to do, either... But I think we have to find a way with our own strength, rather than relying on someone else.」

670:t_1:117.en:
$$モロイ$$
「This won't do. It seems I've been losing heart.」

670:t_1:118.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「That's right! Times like this are when we have to stay positive!」

670:t_1:119.en:
$$カイエン$$
「You've learned to speak up, $$アマタ$$.」

670:t_1:120.en:
$$アマタ$$
「We probably can't beat those $$御使い$$s if we keep relying on someone else forever, either.」

670:t_1:121.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Yeah! We can't let bastards who think humans are their pets keep throwing their weight around.」

670:t_1:122.en:
$$カグラ$$
「I'll smash $$ミカゲ$$, smash $$バアル$$, and smash those bastards, too!」

670:t_1:123.en:
$$クレア$$
「They seem to be all right...」

670:t_1:124.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You needn't worry, Chairwoman $$クレア$$. The $$エレメント$$s are growing, too.」

670:t_1:125.en:
$$アムロ$$
「They'll move forward under their own power, just as both Supreme Commanders $$不動$$ wished.」

670:t_1:126.en:
$$クレア$$
「...You knew $$不動ＧＥＮ#pilot$$ as well, Captain $$アムロ$$.」

670:t_1:127.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$不動ＧＥＮ#pilot$$ and $$不動ＺＥＮ$$... I do not intend to ask about their relationship.」

670:t_1:128.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But I believe both trained the $$エレメント$$s and us with the same goal in mind.」

670:t_1:130.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...Looking back, he probably knew everything, and deliberately refrained from intervening.」

670:t_1:131.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I believe that is what it means... to guide others.」

670:t_1:132.en:
$$クレア$$
「Yes, it is... And the $$エレメント$$s are steadily following the path $$不動$$ showed them, faster than he ever imagined.」

670:t_1:133.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I believe that applies to more than just them. It applies to us... no, to all of humanity.」

670:t_1:134.en:
$$アムロ$$
(But we are approaching the point where our resolve can no longer hold...)

670:t_1:135.en:
$$アムロ$$
(Cracks will begin with those whose mental exhaustion has passed its limit... That man will never overlook them...)

670:t_1:139.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$　Deck～

670:t_1:141.en:
$$ランカ$$
「...I'm sorry, $$アルト$$... You're busy, too, and I've made you indulge my selfish request...」

670:t_1:142.en:
$$アルト$$
「I don't mind. Anyone would be anxious in a situation like this.」

670:t_1:143.en:
$$アルト$$
「Besides, the squad leader asked me to look after you.」

670:t_1:144.en:
$$ランカ$$
「You're keeping me company because my brother told you to...?」

670:t_1:145.en:
$$アルト$$
「That isn't why I'm doing it.」

670:t_1:146.en:
$$ランカ$$
「...You're so kind, $$アルト$$... But that... hurts sometimes...」

670:t_1:148.en:
$$ランカ$$
「I'm sorry... But I... think I've reached my limit...」

670:t_1:149.en:
$$ランカ$$
「I think it's unfair to do this when $$シェリル$$ isn't here... But... if I'm going to die here like this...」

670:t_1:150.en:
$$アルト$$
「Stop, $$ランカ$$. Don't give up hope.」

670:t_1:155.en:
$$アルト$$
「I won't return $$ランカ$$'s feelings.」
「I will return $$ランカ$$'s feelings.」

670:t_1:159.en:
$$ランカ$$
「It's strange, isn't it...? Hearing how you feel is much... much scarier than singing in the middle of a battle...」

670:t_1:163.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The seeds of hatred and jealousy finally bear fruit. I've come for you, girl with the grass-green hair.」

670:t_1:164.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ミカゲ$$! When did you get aboard the $$クォーター$$?!」

670:t_1:166.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Now, come with me, along with your unrequited feelings.」

670:t_1:168.en:
$$アルト$$
「Thank you, $$ランカ$$. Your feelings... make me happy.」
